root_cause.text: The mempolicy object is freed immediately via kmem_cache_free() in __mpol_put() without waiting for an RCU grace period, while concurrent readers in __futex_key_to_node() that access vma->vm_policy under speculative mmap lock and RCU can dereference the freed pointer, causing a use-after-free.
root_cause.evidence: CVE description states: "vma->vm_policy is read under speculative mmap lock and RCU. Concurrently, mbind() may call vma_replace_policy() which frees the old mempolicy immediately via kmem_cache_free(). This creates a race where __futex_key_to_node() dereferences a freed mempolicy pointer." The patch addresses this by adding an rcu_head to struct mempolicy, changing __mpol_put() to use kfree_rcu() instead of kmem_cache_free(), and using READ_ONCE/WRITE_ONCE for vma->vm_policy.
